title: 17 May 2012 GOES-13/15 EPEAD east-west SEP access
notes: The A/B physical look directions for the May 2012 event follow Rodriguez et al. (2014), Table 2.
P1.1 fixes the GOES flux-product policy explicitly; regenerated rows record the exact east/west NOAA source variable names.
P1.2 science references use NOAA/NCEI one-minute GOES ephemeris. Nominal GEO slots are a legacy override only.
P1.3 derives a common time-dependent spectral shape from physical-WEST P4/P5 flux by default; an independent spectrum file is preferred when available.

The default uncorrected-flux synthetic response includes the documented P4/P5 secondary proton energy ranges through 150/190 MeV using GOES 8-15 Z89/Panametrics geometrical factors normalized to each primary channel; the current C19 angular model remains an energy-only approximation to those side/rear responses.
